messages:
OpsLead: Heads-up: running a global surge soak + SLO policy change dry-run on 2026-05-12 01:00-03:00 UTC. Purpose: validate adaptive SLO throttling + weighted error-budget behavior under synthetic traffic. Affects routing, rate-limiting, and alerting only. No customer data changes.
Infra-Oncall: Im owning the window. Plan: start with 10m low-rate canary to validate throttling hooks, then 30m progressive soak at 2x normal traffic, then one 10m 5x spike. Will monitor enforced throttles and circuit-breaker events.
Nina: Please ensure Dedicated tenants with strict SLAs are exempt from throttling tests (tenant-alpha, tenant-phi). Update the exclude list in the control plane.
OpsLead: Exemptions noted. We will route dedicated pins to control-plane-bypass during the test. Also enable verbose telemetry for token-level drops.
deploy-bot: Dry-run job queued: adaptive-slo-dryrun-20260512. Auto-start 01:05 UTC unless manual start at 01:00 UTC.
EngProduct: Reminder: this is a policy dry-run. No external customer communication planned, but Customer Success will be on standby to answer questions if any dedicated tenant sees anomalies.
SRE-bot: SLO alert overrides scheduled: 01:00-03:30 UTC. Alert suppression will be lifted gradually 03:00-03:30 UTC. Post-action telemetry will be collected into /artifacts/slo-dryrun-20260512.
Infra-Oncall: Preflight checklist: verify exclusion list, enable debug sampling on rate-limiter, ensure rollback flag present (policy.enforcement=false). Will post preflight output at 22:30 UTC tonight and live updates during the window.
Nina: Also add a temporary Console banner during the dry-run noting internal policy test (internal-only). Keeps visibility for any internal ops that notice user-impact.
OpsLead: Agreed. Postmortem criteria: any customer-facing error-rate > 1.2x baseline for > 10m or any unplanned Dedicated throttles. If triggered, run the postmortem template and escalate to ENG leadership.
Infra-Oncall: Acknowledged. Starting canary at 01:05 UTC unless @OpsLead cancels. Will DM if we hit rollback thresholds.
OpsLead: Thanks team  short replies here during the window please. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/adaptive-slo-dryrun-2026-05-12
